Package com.example.lotterize.ui.eventsRegistered

Class EventsRegisteredViewModel

ViewModel
com.example.lotterize.ui.eventsRegistered.EventsRegisteredViewModel
Direct Known Subclasses:
FakeEventsRegisteredViewModel
public class EventsRegisteredViewModel extends ViewModel
EventsRegisteredViewModel manages and provides the list of events that the current user is registered for in the Lotterize application. This ViewModel handles data retrieval from Firebase Firestore, transforms it into Event objects, and exposes it via
invalid reference 
LiveData
so that the UI can automatically update when data changes.

    • getRegisteredEvents

      public <any> getRegisteredEvents()
      Returns the LiveData object containing the list of registered events. Observing this LiveData allows the UI to automatically refresh when new registered events are loaded from Firestore.
      Returns:
      LiveData containing the list of Event objects.
